reproduce.description: Every data file the notebooks and experiments load, plus processed caches and validation inputs. Re-run any notebook or experiment without rebuilding. v1.3.0 adds the canonical coupling (pi_canonical.npy, pi_canonical_sharp.npy, trust_multisource_canonical.npz), which load_pi() returns, together with _schaefer_order.txt and the three mouse reference volumes the glass-brain panels need. v1.2.0 and earlier omitted all seven.

raw.description: Full raw data_external/ for a bitwise rebuild of the coupling via pipeline/. Hosted on the original record 20733163; unchanged since v1.0.0 and deliberately not re-uploaded with each version.

_concept_doi_note: Version-independent DOI: always resolves to the latest version. Cite this one in papers; the version DOI above pins the exact bundle this manifest fetches.
